method.name: GTL statistical pace
method.description: For each statistic, 60% of the last three recorded appearances plus 40% of the season-to-date average, using only games before the selected week. At least two recorded appearances are required. Weekly estimates exclude byes, non-active rosters and reported Out or Doubtful players. Rest-of-season totals multiply that pace by scheduled regular-season games from the selected week through Week 18, assuming an active-roster player is available for all of them. No injury return date, depth-chart role or matchup adjustment is forecast. Overall means total fantasy points, not draft value. These are descriptive pace estimates, not published expert rankings.
